newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti gains SIAB stake from Tecnost.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti gains SIAB stake from Tecnost.

text.p: Italy's specialist computer group Tecnost, controlled by Olivetti, said on Tuesday it is tranferring its 51 percent equity stake in SIAB SA to Olivetti for 28 billion lire.

SIAB is an industrial joint venture with French group Bull that develops and manufacturers self service banking equipment. Formed in 1986, it has an annual output of more than 7,000 systems which its sells to Olivetti, Bull and other groups.
Olivetti said in a statement that the move is consistent with its strategy of focusing on sectors such as banking branch automation.

As part of this programme, Tecnost is acquiring the remaining 11 percent of Tecnotour SpA, which produces products and systems for traffic management, thus raising its ownership to a full 100 percent.
